name: Reverie: an odd sim date
source:
"I'm so tired, so exhausted. I just want to fall into a dream and never wake up."

And so she did. You will be playing as Akiyama Asuka, a pretty, bitter and materialistic high school girl. After falling asleep from exhaustion, she wakes up one day and find herself trapped in Reverie, a world of her dreams. You will have 30 days to figure out how to go back... Or stay forever.

[From [URL=http://unseensnow.blogspot.com.au/2014/09/reverie-odd-sim-date.html]Jane Snow's Blog[/URL]]
